dhp423:8: So many in the first section: fourteen verses in the Pairs Vagga, nine in the Diligence Vagga, nine in the Mind Vagga, twelve in the Flowers Vagga, fifteen in the Fool Vagga, eleven in the Astute Vagga, ten in the Perfected Ones Vagga, fourteen in the Thousands Vagga, twelve in the Wickedness Vagga, eleven in the Rod Vagga, nine in the Old Age Vagga, ten in the Self Vagga, eleven in the World Vagga, nine in the Buddhas Vagga, eight in the Happiness Vagga, nine in the Beloved Vagga, eight in the Anger Vagga, twelve in the Stains Vagga, ten in the Just Vagga, twelve in the Path Vagga, nine in the Miscellaneous Vagga, nine in the Hell Vagga, eight in the Elephants Vagga, twelve in the Craving Vagga, twelve in the Mendicants Vagga, forty in the Brahmins Vagga—that makes fifty-three, three thousand
